name: Forgetful Sap
body:
Price 12,335 gp; Slot none; CL 3rd; Weight 1 lb.; Aura faint enchantment and illusion

DESCRIPTION

This smallish blackjack of matte-finish leather is a +1 deceptive sap that can wipe away the memories of a creature struck by it. A hit with a forgetful sap affects the target as memory lapse (DC 12). The save DC of this effect is increased by 2 if the target is unaware of the attacker and by 2 on a confirmed critical hit; these increases stack if both apply. Once the target fails its save, further hits do not further erase its memory. However, as a standard action the wielder of a forgetful sap can make a melee touch attack against a creature wearing light or no armor and with a natural armor bonus to AC of +5 or less. This attack deals no damage but affects the target as memory lapse, as noted above.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 6,330 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells memory lapse, misdirection
